points.description: States FALSE (the user process cannot force a context switch to / schedule a chosen target process next).
Justification: only the scheduler (OS kernel) decides which process runs next; a user process cannot make that decision.
points.partial_credit: Half if stated vaguely, e.g. says the OS controls scheduling without naming the scheduler as the decider.

points.description: Even if the user process tries to influence it (e.g. via signals), there is no guarantee the scheduler will run the target next.

rubric.notes: Full marks need FALSE plus a correct justification that only the scheduler decides the next process, and that attempts such as signals give no guarantee. If the justification is missing or wrong, give 0 overall, as the question states. Part marks for FALSE with a vague or partly correct reason; TRUE earns nothing.
